card.text: M35 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 839 parsecs away.

sources.label: Hunt & Reffert (2023), Improving the open cluster census. II. An all-sky cluster catalogue with Gaia DR3, A&A 673, A114; CDS J/A+A/673/A114, Table 3 (clusters), NGC_2168: dist50, the median of the maximum-likelihood distance, 838.53354927 pc (16th to 84th percentile 838 to 839)
Wikipedia, "Messier 35"
sources.quote: Messier 35 or M35, also known as NGC 2168 or the Shoe-Buckle Cluster, is a relatively close open cluster of stars in the west of Gemini, at about the declination of the Sun when the latter is at June solstice.

introduction.text: M35 is drawn as 1,106 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
